name: Wilbur AI charter assistant on Instagram DMs (PrivateJet.com)
summary: PrivateJet.com, a Miami-based charter broker, expanded its AI assistant Wilbur to Instagram direct messages in a press release on October 29, according to Access Newswire, with further coverage into early November. Users message the broker's Instagram account (@PrivateJet) to explore flight options, compare aircraft, estimate charter costs, ask aviation questions and receive sample quotes. Wilbur draws on more than one million charter quotes from PrivateJet.com's internal data. Michael Loff, director of charter sales, said people want to understand the right aircraft and cost without waiting to speak with someone. Wilbur supports the early stages of the charter process; PrivateJet.com aviation advisors complete bookings when the traveler is ready. Wilbur is also available on PrivateJet.com. The company calls it the first AI private jet broker assistant available through Instagram direct messages.

whyItMatters: Charter and FBO inquiries arrive nights and weekends on social apps, and every unanswered DM is a trip that may go to another broker. Meeting the customer where they already chat, with a fast ballpark quote, keeps the conversation warm until a person closes it. Before you copy the idea, decide which quotes an AI may give and which still need a human, and measure how many Instagram or WhatsApp inquiries you lose after hours today.
pricing: Not published; broker membership model separate from Wilbur
